If the mapping is LOSSY (measure-specific policies formatDisplayNumber cannot express): fall back to (a) — thread a locale parameter per the #4272 playbook — and record the surviving duplication as a comment at both ends.
2. **Widgets thread `useDisplayLocale()`** (the one channel) at the DatasetWidget / ObjectMetric / pivot call sites — parameter lands WITH its consumers, never speculatively.
3. Red-first on de/zh sessions per surface; en pinned byte-identical at every touched site (see the discriminator above); the #4487 flake lives in DatasetWidget's suite — its protocol applies (verify locally + rerun before owning a red).
4. Changesets: '@object-ui/core' per its measured .d.ts (optional param on an entry export ⇒ minor; internal rewiring only ⇒ patch — say which); plugin-dashboard per its diff. Never major.

**Sequencing:** gate worktree creation on PR #4565 reaching origin/main (armed on green CI — both cards touch plugin-dashboard, different files, but the gate is minutes and removes all doubt). **Mutual exclusion:** ⛔ #4548 in flight owns packages/react + consumer fixes in plugin-dashboard DashboardRenderer.tsx / DashboardGridLayout.tsx — do NOT touch those two files; DatasetWidget/ObjectMetric/recordFields are clear. #4305 (app-shell flow), #4564 (types/data-objectstack), #4549 (StudioDesignSurface) disjoint.
